vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 contains an insecure JNDI lookup feature that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal and Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access files outside the document root.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Spring Cloud Gateway Code Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Spring Cloud Gateway contains a code injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Jenkins CLI Arbitrary File Read Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Jenkins CLI contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read arbitrary files.
